name: How long does it typically take to build a multi-unit property?

mainEntity.name: How long does it typically take to build a multi-unit property?

acceptedAnswer.text: The construction timeline for a multi-unit property varies significantly based on factors like size, complexity, site conditions, and local permitting processes. A smaller duplex might take 10-14 months, while a larger apartment building could require 18-36 months or more from groundbreaking to completion. This estimate does not include the pre-construction phases such as design, financing, and permitting, which can add several months to a year.
acceptedAnswer.description: Construction time for a multi-unit property can range from 10 months for a duplex to over 36 months for larger buildings, excluding pre-construction phases.
